in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrishab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hrishab is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Hrishah, which means 'lord' or 'master'. The name Hrishab is often used to denote the lord of the universe or the ruler of all creation. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is associated with the god Vishnu, who is considered the preserver of the universe.
